question: Should the public docs site prioritize the latest released configuration shape until the `memory.search` migration ships, or should it expose current-main configuration with an explicit version requirement and stable-release alternative?
rationale: Current main is internally consistent, but the report concerns a released installation; selecting one documentation shape without a versioning rule would knowingly mislead one supported audience.

options.title: Show stable configuration by default
options.body: Keep `agents.defaults.memorySearch` in the public quick-start until the release containing `memory.search` is available, with a current-main note if needed.

options.title: Publish both versioned examples
options.body: Retain the stable example and add a clearly version-gated `memory.search` example for the upcoming/current-main schema.

recommendation.title: Show stable configuration by default
recommendation.body: Keep `agents.defaults.memorySearch` in the public quick-start until the release containing `memory.search` is available, with a current-main note if needed.
